QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_18

question.text: For a close-ended Category III AIF, Incentive Fees are typically computed and payable:

answer.text: After completion of the fund tenure or at a 3-year cycle, as per the PPM

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.1: For close-ended Cat III AIFs, incentive fees are typically computed after completion of fund tenure, OR at a 3-year cycle — to avoid double-counting excess return and to allow for future losses. The Trap: Options A and C would cause double-counting of profits. Option D is tied to capital drawdown, not performance. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B covers crystallisation; XIX-C requires manager to reconcile accrued carry vs paid carry in LP statements. Manager's Pro-Tip: Accrue carry daily for accurate NAV reporting (GIPS requires this) but pay at crystallisation. The accrual figure drives unit pricing for redemptions/subscriptions — a material fair-value consideration.
